title: kate-core: score a case-insensitive subsequence
summary: fuzzy_match scores a case-insensitive subsequence. The score rules are in this packet. Quick open can call it later. This packet does not draw a palette. It does not add a dependency. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Positions are Unicode scalar indexes in the candidate. An empty pattern returns score 0 and no positions. No subsequence returns None. Compare scalars without case. Each match adds 16. Index 0 adds 8. A previous scalar that is not ASCII alphanumeric adds 8. The next scalar after the previous match adds 8. Each skipped scalar between matches subtracts 1. Do not subtract before the first match. lib.rs re-exports FuzzyHit and fuzzy_match. Do not edit kate-ui. A new Rust file starts with the LGPL-2.1-or-later SPDX header. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: fuzzy::tests::foo_bar_scores_the_documented_hits
regression_tests.asserts: fuzzy_match of fb against foo_bar returns score 45 and positions 0 and 4. FB against fooBar returns score 38 and positions 0 and 3.

regression_tests.name: fuzzy::tests::a_missing_subsequence_returns_none
regression_tests.asserts: fb against bar returns None. An empty pattern returns score 0 and no positions.
